description: Default tolerances for tools/benchmark/image_validation.py (RGB/colour validation). The module's DEFAULT_TOLERANCES carries the same values; this file is the documented copy the CLI accepts with --tolerances. Units are 0-255 per-channel values. A pass requires every limit to hold (limits are inclusive); black or uniform images are inconclusive, never a pass.

documentation.max_mae: Overall mean absolute error over the R/G/B channels. The primary same-frame gate: two captures of the same static frame differ by compression noise (tens of a level), not by several levels.
documentation.max_channel_mae: Per-channel mean absolute error. Catches one channel drifting even when the overall mean stays low (a colour cast).
documentation.max_p99: Per-channel and overall 99th percentile of the absolute difference. Catches sparse but strong corruption that a mean would hide.
documentation.max_bad_fraction: Fraction of pixels with any colour channel differing by more than pixel_diff_threshold. Catches a localised defect on a small part of the frame.
documentation.pixel_diff_threshold: Per-channel absolute difference above which a pixel counts as bad for max_bad_fraction.
documentation.max_region_mae: Worst region of the region_grid must stay below this mean absolute error. A localised corruption (for example an overlay on one part of the scene) can pass the whole-image mean while failing here.
documentation.region_grid: Region grid used for the region statistics: an int for a square grid or [columns, rows]. Default 4x4.
documentation.black_luma_threshold: A channel value at or below this is 'near zero' for black-frame and half-black detection.
documentation.black_fraction_max: The candidate is black when every colour channel has at least this fraction of near-zero pixels. Black is inconclusive, never a pass.
documentation.stereo_side_by_side: Enable the stereo side-by-side checks: missing/black eye and duplicated (identical) halves.
documentation.min_eye_energy: A stereo half whose non-black pixel fraction is below this is treated as a missing eye and fails.
documentation.eye_identical_mae: Left/right halves whose mean absolute difference is at or below this are treated as identical; if the reference halves differ, a duplicated eye fails.
documentation.channel_swap_improvement: The R/B-swapped comparison is materially better when its MAE is at most this fraction of the direct MAE while the direct comparison already fails max_mae.
documentation.min_std: An image whose colour-channel standard deviation is below this carries no structure and is inconclusive.
